title: Embodied fly, stage 2a: does the male nerve cord produce a walking rhythm from its walking command neuron? (SIMULATED, fictive: no body)
roadmap: report/ROADMAP_EMBODIED_FLY.md, stage 2 (feeding and walking); this is its walking half's first test, on motor neurons alone, before any body
seen_before_registration: every stage-1 result; in stages 1c and 1d (seeds 730-747, 1 s), forward-walking (BDN2, DNg100) drive moved the left front leg's claw rhythmically (rhythmicity 0.46) and drove the left hind-leg motor pool hardest; no other leg's time course was looked at
data only: tibia flexor motor neurons on every leg (5-9 per leg) and tibia extensor motor neurons (2 per leg)

design.network: the stage-1c nerve cord (male CNS, brain removed, w_syn 0.275 mV)
design.drive_rate: 150 Hz Poisson to each driven neuron
design.signals: for each of the six legs, the tibia flexor pool and the tibia extensor pool (motor neurons of that type, subclass and soma side): spike trains filtered (exponential, tau 20 ms) into rates at 1 ms, averaged over the pool; analysed from 0.2 to 2.0 s
design.rhythmicity: fly.kinematics.rhythmicity on a signal: the largest normalized autocorrelation at lags 50-500 ms
design.phase: of signal b relative to a: the period P is the lag of a's largest autocorrelation within 50-500 ms; the phase is k/P for the lag k in [0, P) at which the normalized cross-correlation of a(t) and b(t+k) is largest; undefined (counts as a failure) if either pool fires below 1 Hz on average
design.closeness: circular distance between phases, min(|p - q|, 1 - |p - q|); per prediction the median over trials

W0_silent_without_drive.statement: Without drive no leg motor neuron fires
W0_silent_without_drive.test: no spikes in any of the twelve pools in any no-drive trial

W1_the_walking_command_makes_a_rhythm.statement: BDN2 drive makes the left front tibia flexor pool rhythmic, more than grooming drive does
W1_the_walking_command_makes_a_rhythm.test: median rhythmicity under forward walking >= 0.3 and above the grooming median

W2_antagonists_alternate.statement: Within the left front leg, tibia flexors and extensors alternate
W2_antagonists_alternate.test: median circular distance of phase(L1 flexor -> L1 extensor) from 0.5 <= 0.15

W3_left_and_right_alternate.test: median circular distance of phase(L1 flexor -> R1 flexor) from 0.5 <= 0.15

W4_a_tripod.statement: Neighbouring legs on one side alternate and the front and hind legs move together, as in a tripod gait
W4_a_tripod.test: median circular distance of phase(L1 -> L2 flexor) from 0.5 <= 0.15 and of phase(L1 -> L3 flexor) from 0 <= 0.15

not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: that the fly walks: there is no body, no sensory feedback, and the drive is a stimulated command neuron; a pass means the connectome-only nerve cord turns the walking command into an alternating, coordinated motor rhythm
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls; backward-walking phases reported without a prediction.
